scripts.lint: find . -name vendor -prune -o -name node_modules -prune -o -name .claude -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.php' -o -name '*.inc' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite. The db and http tests need a database and the module served from a FrontAccounting install - docker/fa-sgw-sales test provides both.
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every PHP and .inc file in the module.
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Check includes/db, includes/common and tests/ against PSR-12 (phpcs.xml). Not yet clean, so it is deliberately not part of quality/ci; docker/fa-sgw-sales lint reports it without failing.
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fix what phpcbf can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.quality: lint, then analyze - the two static gates.
scripts-descriptions.ci: quality, then test - the same gates GitHub Actions runs through docker/fa-sgw-sales.
scripts-descriptions.package: Build the release zip and tarball (needs make.phar; docker/fa-sgw-sales make package).
